title: Garden-Audit Doc
description: Intermediate contract produced by garden-audit.py and consumed by garden-audit-render.py. Carries run metadata, per-tier findings, skipped-checks info, and the reappeared-exclusions list for the report preamble.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this scan run.

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the scan was produced.

profile.description: Vault profile name in use (miyo, lyt, …).

skipped_checks.description: Check names skipped due to external tool unavailability (e.g. graph unavailable).

skipped_checks_reason.description: Human-readable reason why checks were skipped.

reappeared_exclusions.description: Raw exclusion dicts for expired-temporary exclusions — surfaced in the report preamble.

advisory_pushback_days.description: Rest window in days for an acknowledged advisory (from exclusions settings, default 30). Carried in the doc so the renderer can label the Acknowledge checkbox without loading config.

fixable.description: True for checks 1-4 (unparented,orphan,broken_up,dead_link). False for advisory checks 5-6.

target.description: The primary note or path this finding targets.

detail.description: Per-check detail. Fields vary by check type.

candidate_mocs.description: unparented/orphan: scored MOC candidates from orphan_link.

up_target.description: broken_up: the broken up:: target stem.

dead_target.description: dead_link: the unresolved wikilink target text.

count.description: dead_link: how many times the dead link appears.

dupes.description: duplicate_stem: list of paths sharing the stem.

mtime.description: stale_moc: last-modified ISO timestamp from listDir.

decision.description: Present only on fixable findings. Carries the pre-selected action placeholder for Pass-2.

selected.description: Whether this fix is pre-selected for application.

action.description: Proposed action name or null when no action determined yet.
